name: App stuck on loading and ad-heavy login
description: Users report the app freezing on the loading screen or being unable to get into their account, alongside excessive ads.

name: Password rejected during sign-in
description: Users say the app will not accept their password when trying to log in.

name: Premium-only features making app worthless
description: A user feels the update forces premium payment for the creator's benefit, making the free app unusable.

name: Restrictions and ads push premium upgrade
description: Users feel too many restrictions and ads make the app useless unless they pay for premium.

name: Free users lose skip and song selection
description: Users say the recent update restricted skipping, going back, and choosing specific songs to premium subscribers only.

name: Missing songs and limited gospel music
description: Users say many songs are absent from the catalog and gospel music coverage is thin.

name: Lyrics missing or inconsistently shown
description: Users report lyrics appear for some songs but not others, and sometimes fail to show at all.

name: Switched from Pandora for podcasts
description: A user moved to Spotify to listen to a specific podcast and stopped using Pandora.

name: Recommendations clutter playlists and changed
description: Users dislike recommendations inserted into their playlists and feel the recommendation quality or variety has declined.

name: Background downloads get stuck
description: A user says song downloads stall in the background until the app is reopened.

name: Offline mode not working
description: A user reports that offline playback does not work.

name: Assorted complaints about the app
description: Users leave brief negative reviews calling the app worst or useless after updates, with some citing voice assistant playback failures and other unrelated complaints.

name: Wi-Fi connection failures and poor quality
description: A premium user says the app fails to connect over Wi-Fi while mobile data works, and some songs sound worse than on other apps.

name: App crashes or won't open after update
description: A user says the latest update makes the app crash so it cannot be opened.

name: Playback stops and does not resume
description: A user reports music stops midway and does not return to where it left off, starting a different song instead.

name: Frequent ads interrupting songs
description: Users say ads play every song or two, are very loud, and are excessive even for free listeners.

name: Ads, bugs, and general dissatisfaction
description: Users complain about premium ad prompts, ads replacing songs, and bugs such as broken music adjustment, leading some to uninstall.

name: Playlist shuffling and homescreen redesign
description: Users dislike playlists playing songs out of order and the new homescreen that makes browsing one item at a time.

name: Shuffle forced and replay controls removed
description: Users say they cannot pick, repeat, or replay specific songs or sections, and that the app forces shuffle.

name: Basic player features removed in redesign
description: Users say recent updates removed basic music player functions such as going back a few seconds and replaying parts, while one user praised the blend feature.
